verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS marketing and CRM platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions open-source code, a public repository, or a license. The official SDKs are noted, but nothing says their source is openly licensed, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
